async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Navigate directly to the product reviews page
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/review/product/', wait_until='networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Wait for page to load completely
    # On the reviews page, find the search input for review content
    # Assuming there's a textbox with a label or placeholder for search
    search_box = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search Reviews')
    await search_box.fill('satisfied')
    # Find and click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    # Print the page content to capture the review count
    body_text = await page.text_content('body')
    print(body_text)
